author: Dillon Finlay
text:
You can try SkinTac or 3M’s Cavilon Barrier. Both will protect your skin from the adhesive and help it stick better. 

Clean the area, use the alcohol pad and then let it dry, then apply the barrier film or SkinTac. Wait like 30 seconds and then apply the sensor. That’s my process and I haven’t had any trouble since I started doing that.
